executive_summary:
# EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

B — PARTIAL / CORE REPAIR VERIFIED; PRESENTATION REMAINS CONSERVATIVE

The historical structured milestone refusal was independently reproduced in the real browser before source edits. Root cause is an implementation omission: action() persisted its successful discovery but never invoked PR66 response publication. Both input paths now use the same post-persistence publisher and mandatory verifier. No deterministic resolver, campaign fixture, HTTP projection or frontend code changed.

Immediate browser milestone narration and World journal now both communicate the exact authorized footprint discovery. Five browser actions and five separate live-provider TCP actions complete. Four real provider requests / 2003 tokens produce one accepted and published presentation, two correct duplicate rejections and one harmless false rejection. Three deterministic investigation fallbacks; movement is engine-authored. Zero postrepair mandatory omissions, critical unsafe AI publications or complete-payload hidden sentinel exposures in executed checks.

53 development checks pass; developer-authored frozen holdout passes once 50/50. Focused regression: 893 passed / same three historical failures; boundary: 82 passed; broader: same nine historical failures. Matched raw authoritative comparison passes 5/5. Experimental gates remain default off and session-bound. No commit or push. This is a reproduced bounded repair, not an official ATGB result or independent external evaluation.

Partial because harmless target wording remains rejected and repeat fallback prose remains redundant. Primary next step: Narrowly distinguish an exact current-action target reference (mud prints) from discovery repetition in the existing overlap check, preserving whole-segment rejection of factual expansions; use a fresh holdout. Do not start a broad validator cycle.
